entry.title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO

entry.title: Cloudflare Lifts Annual Profit Outlook, Beats Wall Street Target
entry.summary: Cloudflare Inc. gave a forecast for profit this year that topped Wall Street’s estimates, suggesting that demand for networking services continued to accelerate amid rapid adoption of artificial intelligence.

entry.title: DeepSeek Resumes $8 Billion Round With Monolith in the Running
entry.summary: DeepSeek has resumed its second funding round, seeking close to $8 billion, with Monolith Management in talks to contribute, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: China’s Unitree Seeks $904 Million in First Mainland Robotic IPO
entry.summary: China’s Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, is seeking to raise about 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million) in an initial public offering that would make it the mainland’s first publicly traded humanoid robot maker.
